scope.purpose: Completeness/current-norm and semantic-granularity audit of the full Grade-8 cross-grade bank. No physical bank mutation in this wave.

current_academic_crosscheck.source: Gramota.ru — complicated sentences / generalizing words / introductory constructions / addresses
Gramota.ru — direct speech with author words

granularity_policy: Do not merge units merely because they share a school chapter; merge only identical learner decisions.
Do not split one structured decision engine into one denominator unit per branch.
A current normative branch may be broader than the exact Grade-8 source route; route provenance stays narrow.
Punctuation mechanisms that require materially different reconstruction algorithms may remain separate sibling identities.

decisions.current_model: A school phrase is a combination of independent words linked by subordinate relation. Coordinated combinations and the predicative subject-predicate basis are not treated as phrases in the mainstream school model.
decisions.current_caution: There are broader linguistic traditions for the term словосочетание; the unit should explicitly remain within the school classification model.

decisions.diagnostic_model: Classify by the grammatical behavior of the dependent component, not by part-of-speech name alone.

current_scope: numeral/nominal combinations where the academic dash rule applies
ЭТО/ВОТ/ЗНАЧИТ-like linking structures under the corresponding syntax
decisions.semantic_overlap_check: Distinct from school-dash-subject-predicate-no-dash-boundaries and school-dash-subject-predicate-closing-comma-boundary: base placement, suppression/context and punctuation interaction are different learner decisions.

decisions.route_policy: Назывное is added to current normative scope only; no Grade-8 source route is invented from the Drabkina evidence.
decisions.patch_policy: Broaden the classification engine to the full current school taxonomy while preserving exact source-route provenance.

current_diagnostics: possibility of coordinating И as a useful but not infallible test
decisions.learner_policy: Do not reduce to the mechanical possibility of inserting И; semantics and structure remain decisive.

decisions.current_model: First decide whether single И connects homogeneous members inside one predicative structure or separate predicative clauses; punctuation follows that structural classification.
decisions.semantic_overlap_check: Distinct from Grade-9 school-ssp-no-comma-common-element-boundary, which applies only after the compound-clause structure is already established and then tests a special no-comma condition.

decisions.current_model: A shared dependent component is grammatical only when the coordinated governing words are compatible with the same case/prepositional government. Different government requires separate dependent structures.
decisions.semantic_overlap_check: The alias school-homogeneous-predicate-shared-dependent-government remains non-counted; the Grade-8 and Grade-11 routes belong to one identity.

decisions.current_model: Repeated coordinating conjunctions normally require commas between homogeneous members, with documented exceptions for tight semantic pairs and fixed expressions.
decisions.semantic_overlap_check: Distinct from paired/double conjunctions: repeated same conjunction and paired correlative constructions have different structural diagnostics.

decisions.current_model: Adversative conjunction relation is punctuated according to the homogeneous-member construction; this is separate from repeated and paired conjunction algorithms.

decisions.semantic_overlap_check: Distinct from Grade-11 school-generalizing-word-insertion-punctuation-boundary, whose decision involves А ИМЕННО / НАПРИМЕР / КАК-ТО and post-list summary connectors.

current_scope: usuality and related current introductory meanings
decisions.semantic_overlap_check: This is general recognition/classification; context-sensitive ОДНАКО/ЗНАЧИТ/НАКОНЕЦ/ВООБЩЕ units remain separate because they decide homonymous function of particular words.

current_model.introductory_sentence: same semantic class as introductory words; normally isolated by commas, more rarely dashes
current_model.insertion: additional remark structurally outside the base sentence; normally parentheses or paired dashes

decisions.important_correction: Do not describe parentheses/dashes as simply a 'stronger introductory sentence' punctuation scale. Current academic rules distinguish introductory sentences from вставные конструкции.
decisions.counting_policy: Retain one source-backed classification/punctuation engine because the learner task is to distinguish the construction and choose its sign system; do not split denominator unless later source evidence establishes independent mastery units.

current_branches: two or more postpositive single definitions under the academic conditions
definition related to a personal pronoun regardless of position
definition separated from its noun by other sentence material
prepositive definition with additional adverbial/causal meaning where applicable
decisions.learner_policy: Position alone is insufficient in edge cases; referent type, distribution and additional predicative/adverbial meaning matter.

current_model: extended apposition after its noun: standard isolation patterns
prepositive extended apposition: isolated when carrying additional adverbial/causal meaning
restrictive identifying apposition may remain non-isolated
decisions.semantic_overlap_check: Distinct from introducer/function apposition boundary in 188, from hyphenation and from final explanatory dash.

decisions.current_model: Hyphen/dash/solid-separate presentation of appositional naming depends on the syntactic relation, conventional model, extent of the apposition and dictionary fixation. Multiword appositions can require a dash where a single-word apposition would use a hyphen.
decisions.learner_policy: Member-level edge cases require current dictionary control; never infer all appositions take a hyphen.

decisions.current_test: A final apposition that explains/specifies the preceding noun and permits a semantic insertion such as А ИМЕННО can be introduced by a dash.
decisions.semantic_overlap_check: Not the same as the basic generalizing-word colon/dash model or ordinary isolated apposition.

decisions.current_model: A single gerund or gerund phrase expressing a genuine secondary action is normally isolated. Non-isolation and phraseological/adverbial cases remain separate special-case siblings.
decisions.semantic_overlap_check: Distinct from already audited phraseological, adverbial, conjunction-adjacency and two-turn gerund boundaries.

current_scope: how exactly? in the source model
decisions.current_rule: A genuinely clarifying member narrows/specifies the preceding member and is isolated; mere adjacency of two circumstances does not itself prove clarification.
decisions.learner_policy: Establish semantic narrowing before applying commas.

decisions.current_model: An address names the addressee, is not a member of the sentence and is isolated by punctuation according to position and intonation; an initial address may take an exclamation mark.
decisions.core_boundary: Distinguish address from subject or other sentence member before choosing punctuation.

current_branch_families: не кто иной, как / не что иное, как punctuation branch
preceding НЕ / совсем / почти / именно / просто / вроде / совершенно etc.
decisions.semantic_overlap_check: The branch не кто иной, как overlaps in surface form with the Grade-10 НЕ/НИ spelling identity but not in learner decision: this unit owns KAK punctuation/function; the other owns НЕ/НИ and pronoun construction spelling.
decisions.counting_policy: Branch-level diagnostics, one denominator identity; do not inflate by table row.

decisions.current_rule: If the author words interrupt direct speech where no sentence-final sign is required (or a mid-sentence sign belongs there), the author words are framed by comma+dash patterns and the continuation normally starts lowercase according to the structure.
decisions.granularity_note: Keep separate from period and question/exclamation break schemes because the reconstruction algorithm and capitalization differ.

decisions.current_rule: If the interruption occurs at a sentence boundary corresponding to a period, before author words use comma+dash, after them period+dash, and the resumed direct speech begins with a capital letter.
decisions.granularity_note: This is not a duplicate of the comma-break identity: the original break punctuation and continuation capitalization are different learner decisions.

decisions.current_rule: Question/exclamation (and analogous preserved strong signs) before author words are retained and followed by a dash; continuation punctuation/capitalization depends on whether the second direct-speech segment continues the same sentence or starts a new one.
decisions.granularity_note: Separate identity remains justified because the preserved sign and reconstruction scheme differ materially from both comma and period breaks.

current_model: paragraph dialogue: each replica starts on a new line with a dash
author text before a replica ends with colon when it introduces the replica, otherwise a period may be required
inline dialogue and author-word combinations use separate current quote/dash schemes
decisions.semantic_overlap_check: Dialogue layout is not a duplicate of direct-speech interruption by author words; the unit decides replica formatting and author/replica boundaries at dialogue level.
